node.statement: Applying lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation to that eligible global scalar raw call (D=D_*, A_R=A, epsilon_R=epsilon, B_R=C, and u_R=u_0) gives a map v:C->A which is an extended d_R-inclusion for its output map-defect d_R, with d_R <= W.c0_cb*epsilon and ||v(I_C)-I_A|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon; preservation of source, target, and amplification form gives exactly the displayed domain and codomain.
